jobs.description:
Location: Antwerp, Belgium 
 
Languages: English & Spanish
 

About the role We are looking for an exceptional pastry talent — someone who blends the refinement of 
Japanese wagashi with the expressive flavours of 
South America. As our Top Pastry Chef, you’ll create desserts that merge tradition, craftsmanship, and innovation into a unique culinary identity.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

Develop and perfect desserts inspired by Japanese wagashi techniques.
  

•  

Integrate South American flavours and textures into innovative pastry concepts.
  

•  

Collaborate closely with chefs and product development teams to bring ideas to life.
  

•  

Ensure top-level quality, presentation, and consistency across all creations.
  

•  

Mentor and inspire junior pastry chefs.
   

Your profile
 
 

•  

2+ years experience in high end pastry
  

•  

At least 
6 months of training or work experience in Japan, ideally in wagashi or traditional Japanese pastry.
  

•  

Proven experience working in or with South American culinary traditions.
  

•  

Strong aesthetic sense and technical mastery; storytelling through flavour.
  

•  

Fluent in 
English and Spanish; Japanese language skills are a plus.
  

•  

Creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about merging cultures through pastry.
   

What we offer
 
 

•  

A unique opportunity to shape your signature within an international high-end concept.
  

•  

Artistic freedom and room for culinary innovation.
  

•  

Competitive salary and growth potential within a creative, professional environment.

The ATE Test Development Engineer is responsible for the ATE test implementation and optimization making use of our ATE test setup. From the initial ASIC development kick-off until end of life, the ATE Test Development Engineer will be responsible for defining ATE test software and supporting the launch of new products into high volume production. Together with the test engineers in our bench test lab, the ATE Test Development Engineer keeps a clear overview, ensuring a strong overall test methodology. This position is part of the product engineering group of ICsense and cooperates with cross-functional teams of Test engineers, Design (DFT), Product Engineering, Reliability, Foundry.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Responsible for the implementation and performance of production tests of ICsense ASICs, taking into account quality and test performance 
 

• Set up, implementation, debug and optimization of test programs for automated testing 

• Work with ICsense test engineers to correlate bench test results and ATE test results for debug, characterization, … 

• Ensure the test program is scalable (multi-site), re-usable and accurate (GR&R)   

• Drive continuous improvements to product quality and customer satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the product 
 

• Investigate ATE test setup related problems, find the root cause and propose ATE test setup/software adaptations to the project team to overcome these problems 

• Work on yield improvement/test time reduction programs together with the product quality team   

Competencies
 
 

• You have a Master degree in Industrial engineering 

• You have knowledge of test methodologies and equipment to ensure proper testing of ASICs 

• Experience with ATE test development is an asset (internal training will be provided) 

• Experience with one of the main ATE programming languages is required: VBA, C++ or Java 

• Experience with Prober set-up and handling is a strong plus 

• Team player with a strong sense of urgency to meet test requirements on schedule 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written)

• Availability to work on-site 
We offer:

• Work in an international environment and participation in the expansion of the HalfPrice chain into foreign markets.
• The opportunity to participate in projects related to opening new stores.
• Collaboration with teams from various European countries.
• A high degree of autonomy and a real impact on the development of operational processes.
Stable employment and opportunities for professional development.

About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating innovative, effective, and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high levels of productivity. Positioned at the forefront of innovative and sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to cultivate healthy products and enhance their yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job descriptionWe are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented Accounting, Controlling & Billing Officer to join our growing team at Zymofix. You will play a key role in keeping our financial operations running smoothly and accurately as we scale.
 

The ideal candidate combines solid accounting knowledge with a strong controlling mindset and a keen eye for accurate billing and invoicing. You thrive in a dynamic startup environment where initiative and versatility are valued. You will work closely with management and act as the go-to person for financial administration, controlling, and billing.
 

The role requires strong organizational skills, a high degree of autonomy, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Manage day-to-day accounting tasks including accounts payable/receivable, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and expense tracking. 

• Own the billing cycle end-to-end: generate and send customer invoices, monitor payment terms, follow up on outstanding balances, and resolve billing discrepancies. 

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and support the annual audit process. 

• Develop and maintain controlling processes, including cost tracking, margin analysis, and variance reporting against budget. 

• Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and assist with VAT filings and other statutory obligations. 

• Support budgeting and forecasting processes in close collaboration with management. 

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in the accounting system. 

• Monitor cash flow and support working capital management. 

• Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, and reporting efficiency. 
 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

• Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in an accounting, controlling, or billing role. 

• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting standards and VAT regulations. 

• Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Allegro or similar) and MS Office (Excel in particular). 

• Experience with Notion is a plus. 

• High level of accuracy, discretion, and organizational skills. 

• You are a proactive self-starter who can work independently in a fast-moving environment. 

• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail, particularly around numbers and financial data. 

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written in Dutch and English (French is a plus).

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027. 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities
 

We are looking for a Facility Manager with industrial maintenance skills to join our Engineering team. You will be the first point of contact for the building — covering defects, installations, and technical issues — and, as the role grows, you will take on the position of Head of Maintenance for both civil and industrial production assets, building out the facility team over time through new internal hires or external partnerships. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Relocation management: Help prepare, lead, and coordinate the relocation and expansion of current operational activities to the new site. 

• Building and asset management: Make sure the entire building (7,000m² production and office area, plus outside area) remains in good condition; plan and execute preventive maintenance of civil and production assets, and act as the first contact person for technical issues. 

• Security: Implement access control, fire detection and suppression, and burglary and alarm systems to create a secure workplace. 

• Demo industrial plant construction: Co-prepare and guide the construction of the new demo industrial facility for micro-organism production, working in close collaboration with the project engineer to coordinate all building-related construction works — arranging site access, staying informed on progress, safeguarding safety, and communicating with external partners such as welders, electricians etc. when they come to install equipment. 

• Stakeholder & partner management: Collaborate closely with external partners, internal and external engineers, and contractors to ensure smooth project operations and alignment; keep internal and external stakeholders informed and closely coordinate with production on maintenance planning.The role requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team that relies on you. You draw energy from collective success. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A bachelor's degree in Facility Management ,Construction/Building Technology or technical degree like electromechanics . Experience with a proven track record in building and industrial equipment maintenance is a plus, as well as a master's degree in engineering or a related field. 

• Strong technical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, and a hands-on approach to solving technical challenges, ideally combined with industrial process equipment know-how (utilities, pressure equipment, lab facilities, electrical equipment, etc.). 

• Experience managing contractors and other third parties, with a good understanding of the different trades involved (e.g. welders, masons, concrete workers); an established network of maintenance and trade contacts (HVAC, sanitary, electrical, cleaning services, etc.) is a strong plus. 

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to report to different stakeholders. 

• A structured way of working and a high internal quality standard. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.  

The role requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team that relies on you. You draw energy from collective success.

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Job Description & Key Responsibilities
 

We are looking for a Pilot Plant Technician with a critical mindset to join our team. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Operating, maintaining, and analyzing the existing pilot plant installations, covering substrate production, the fermentation section, laboratory analysis, and downstream processing 

• Production of fermentation substrates using a novel thermophysical pretreatment system. 

• Cultivation of microorganisms in several pilot-scale solid-state fermenters. 

• Managing and maintaining the equipment/machine park, carrying out both preventive and reactive maintenance, including troubleshooting technical issues. 

• Assisting with small-scale construction projects (e.g. installing drying ovens, cleanroom ventilation), sometimes coordinating with external contractors. 

• Providing onsite assistance for larger new-build projects as the pilot plant expands.  

 
 

 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A technical bachelor's degree, or equivalent through relevant experience; a degree specifically in (electro)mechanics, biochemistry, or a related field is a plus. 

• Strong mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, and basic electrical knowledge; basic knowledge of engines/motors is an additional asset. 

• The ability to read and interpret technical documents, equipment manuals, and process diagrams. 

• Strong problem-solving abilities and a hands-on approach to technical challenges. 

• Willingness and ability to work safely in hazardous environments (chemicals, high-pressure systems, pilot plants), with strict adherence to safety protocols; proven experience in this area, with a track record of promoting a safety-first culture and taking ownership of on-the-spot hazard assessments, is a plus. 

• Experience with lab analysis and working with microorganisms; knowledge of fermentation processes and hygiene practices is a plus. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.  

The role requires strong technical skills, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. You draw energy from collective success.

We are looking for a Project Engineer with a critical mindset to reinforce our engineering team. You will be responsible for:

Job Description & Key ResponsibilitiesWe are looking for a Scale-up Engineer with a critical mindset to reinforce our engineering team. You will be responsible for:

• Writing up and scheduling the tests required for process development, and planning and helping carry out production runs for both process development and client projects. 

• Expanding and maintaining the new pilot plant by identifying, designing, and building new process units: commissioning new equipment, drafting operating procedures and manuals, and developing improvement proposals. 

• Ensuring safety throughout all pilot plant operations. 

• Producing for clients while building the internal knowledge needed to scale up — reviewing current small-scale processes and equipment, assessing scale-up potential, performing risk analyses, and taking part in the construction and engineering of the new industrial plant, including the commissioning team.

• A hands-on, practical way of working.

• Fermentation know-how: process and equipment design from lab to industrial scale; experience with large-scale/pilot-scale fermentation (from 50 L) is a plus. 

• Proven experience working safely in hazardous environments (chemicals, high-pressure systems, pilot plants) with strict adherence to safety protocols.

Job introduction

When was the last time you translated a business need into a technical solution that could change an entire organization? That’s exactly what you’ll do with us!

As a Senior SAP Development Lead at delaware, you truly understand what businesses need and how we can deliver it. You’re eager to take the lead in transforming ideas into innovative solutions, guide customers through their move to SAP S/4 HANA, and add value to their business processes.

If development is in your DNA and you’re ready to take on a leading role, then you may be the Senior SAP Development Lead we’re looking for.

Who are we?

Did you know delaware is Belgium’s biggest SAP integrator? This means we get to work with the latest SAP technologies, such as all S/4 HANA deployments, SAP Fiori, SAP Cloud Platform services like ABAP Environment, iRPA, HANA Cloud, API Management, and the SAP Business Technology Platform. Enough with the name-dropping though — you probably already know your way around these technologies! And if you don’t, we’ll happily guide you through them .

We are the SAP Development team. We’re a fun-loving and ambitious team with a strong group dynamic. Even though there are more than 60 of us, we’re still a very tight-knit bunch! We love going for drinks together and we organize the best team events. It’s in our nature to coach our teammates: seniors happily share knowledge with newer members of the team (and vice versa). So what’s it like to work with us? ‘Unique,’ ‘adventurous,’ and ‘challenging’ are just three of the words team members have used to describe their experience. Read our stories here.

We have a broad spectrum of projects and customers in a wide variety of sectors and across the entire range of SAP modules. We also offshore development work to our colleagues in Harbin (China), but it’s up to the development lead to decide which tasks stay with us and which are sent to China.

Just so you know: delaware has offices in Antwerp, Ghent, Kortrijk, Lummen, Liège, and Wavre, but we also spend a lot of time working with our customers on-site. We also offer the flexibility to work from home.
